why: A bare hook command fails open on a missing bin. One managed shim turns every failure into exit 2 with a fix line.
what: New: packages/basalt-ui/src/cli/lint/** (the lint verb), agent/templates/hook.mjs.tpl (managed, at most 40 lines), test/fixtures/hook/** (hidden from root lint, fmt, bun test by v3-test-roots) with its runner tests/cli/hook.test.ts. Outside owns: the lint dispatch in src/cli/index.ts (replacing the rel-7 stub) and one line in init/steps.ts registering the hook step.
contract: docs/v3/concepts/skills-agent-layer.md sections 4.1 (lint), 4.2 (hook entries, settings.json merge), 8 (Hook row); guardrails.md sections 8, 9. Read docs/v3/spikes/{hook-sync,lint-edges}.md; no fingerprint filter is built.
exemplar: packages/basalt-ui/src/cli/guard-hook.ts and src/guard/guard-hook.test.ts (2.x hook entry and tests).
change: basalt-ui lint [--file p | --changed | --stats [--write-budget]] [--agent] [--hook post-edit|stop|pre-edit]: runs oxlint, stylelint (.stylelintrc.basalt.json) and checkTokens (extraNames from manifest.extra) per root profile; --agent is terse, names the fix, exits 2 on findings; --hook reads the event JSON on stdin and is exempt from the unknown-flag exit 1; exit 1 on a ceiling breach (countBreaches from src/cli/budget, v3-sk-3b). --stats prints per-rule findings, waivers and escapes; --stats --write-budget calls landBudget, the only writer of the counts besides init's seed: consumers never hand-edit .basalt/budget.json. hook.mjs resolves the bin from the manifest's package dir, runs lint --hook, maps every outcome other than 0 or the child's own 2 to exit 2 with a line naming the fix (bun install or basalt-ui doctor). Stop re-checks at most once per session_id. PreToolUse denies only edits to .basalt/**, managed .claude paths, presets, a settings.json write removing a basalt entry, and a managed id added to the consumer lint config. settings.json merge: parse, identify basalt entries by .basalt/hook.mjs in the command, add or replace only those; unparseable JSON prints the entries and writes nothing. Unflip the .failing invariants naming this Issue. Rule, skill snippet: none.
commits: One PR, rebase-merged. Conventional commits, empty scope, no attribution. Package paths only (isolated-basalt-ui). Never edit CHANGELOG.md.
proof: Hook fixtures run via node .basalt/hook.mjs in scratch repos.
acceptance: A seeded offender returns exit 2 with a finding at post-edit, also from a package subdirectory cwd
Stop returns the agent at most once per session_id; a second call exits 0
A missing bin, a thrown error and an unknown event each exit 2 with a line naming 'bun install' or 'basalt-ui doctor'
Merge fixtures (shutterflow live-library guard, rb settings.json) keep non-basalt entries byte-identical; unparseable JSON is not written
lint exits 1 when counted waivers exceed .basalt/budget.json's; --stats --write-budget updates it via landBudget
out_of_scope: Legacy guard-hook removal (migrate row), doctor check 8 (sk-3a), shot, presets, eject (G1).
